sources.decision_summary: 1909 first-edition scan acquired and Chapter 1 inspected. Identity scheme matches Antar 47/34, but combined English labels require a manual segmentation policy before normalization. No Translation text approved.
known_caveats: Combined English labels observed for 4-6, 21-22, 24-25, 32-34, 38-39.
DjVu OCR aid is not authoritative; Image Container PDF has no usable text layer.
Word-by-word paraphrase and bracketed commentary must not enter translationText.
Running headers such as 45-47] are pagination aids, not combined verse labels.
Authorship debate (Sister Nivedita claim) recorded in Phase 1 risk analysis; attribute as published.
Sacred Texts HTML must not be used as redistribution master.
Rejected IA item in.ernet.dli.2015.237563 is a 1967 reprint.
